description: Config for the standalone Renovate run in .github/workflows/renovate.yml. Automerge is enabled because the Alpine base images are now pinned to explicit releases and need automated bumps. No 'schedule' here on purpose: run timing is owned solely by the workflow cron, so this config never blocks an on-demand workflow_dispatch run. Note: 'comment' is not a Renovate option - using it aborted the whole run with a config-validation error.

packageRules.description: Bump the pinned Alpine base image in all Dockerfiles
Keep GitHub Actions used by the build/CI pipelines current
